constraint neon_auth.users_sync users_sync_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint public.administrators administrators_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint public.administrators administrators_user_id_users_sync_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES neon_auth.users_sync(id)
constraint public.event_images event_images_event_id_events_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id)
constraint public.event_images event_images_event_id_image_id_pk PRIMARY KEY (event_id, image_id)
constraint public.event_images event_images_image_id_images_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (image_id) REFERENCES images(id)
constraint public.event_notes event_notes_event_id_events_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id)
constraint public.event_notes event_notes_event_id_position_pk PRIMARY KEY (event_id, "position")
constraint public.event_notes event_notes_position_check CHECK (("position" >= 0))
constraint public.event_people event_people_event_id_events_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id)
constraint public.event_people event_people_event_id_profile_id_role_pk PRIMARY KEY (event_id, profile_id, role)
constraint public.event_people event_people_position_check CHECK (("position" >= 0))
constraint public.event_people event_people_profile_id_profiles_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles(id)
constraint public.event_people event_people_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['organizer'::text, 'co-host'::text, 'mc'::text])))
constraint public.event_people event_people_source_check CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['luma'::text, 'site'::text])))
constraint public.event_posts event_posts_author_avatar_images_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (author_avatar) REFERENCES images(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
constraint public.event_posts event_posts_event_id_events_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id)
constraint public.event_posts event_posts_image_images_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (image) REFERENCES images(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
constraint public.event_posts event_posts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint public.event_posts event_posts_platform_check CHECK ((platform = ANY (ARRAY['x'::text, 'bluesky'::text, 'linkedin'::text, 'other'::text])))
constraint public.event_posts event_posts_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'hidden'::text, 'pending'::text])))
constraint public.event_posts event_posts_url_unique UNIQUE (url)
constraint public.event_review_sessions event_review_sessions_event_id_events_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraint public.event_review_sessions event_review_sessions_event_id_unique UNIQUE (event_id)
constraint public.event_review_sessions event_review_sessions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint public.event_review_sessions event_review_sessions_thread_id_unique UNIQUE (thread_id)
constraint public.event_schedule_items event_schedule_items_event_id_events_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id)
constraint public.event_schedule_items event_schedule_items_event_id_position_pk PRIMARY KEY (event_id, "position")
constraint public.event_schedule_items event_schedule_items_position_check CHECK (("position" >= 0))
constraint public.event_sponsors event_sponsors_event_id_events_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id)
constraint public.event_sponsors event_sponsors_event_id_sponsor_id_pk PRIMARY KEY (event_id, sponsor_id)
constraint public.event_sponsors event_sponsors_sponsor_id_sponsors_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (sponsor_id) REFERENCES sponsors(id)
constraint public.event_talks event_talks_event_id_events_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id)
constraint public.event_talks event_talks_event_id_talk_id_pk PRIMARY KEY (event_id, talk_id)
constraint public.event_talks event_talks_talk_id_talks_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (talk_id) REFERENCES talks(id)
constraint public.events events_curation_check CHECK ((curation = ANY (ARRAY['ours'::text, 'shared'::text])))
constraint public.events events_curation_organizer_check CHECK (((curation = 'shared'::text) = (organized_by IS NOT NULL)))
constraint public.events events_luma_checked_in_count_check CHECK ((luma_checked_in_count >= 0))
constraint public.events events_luma_event_id_unique UNIQUE (luma_event_id)
constraint public.events events_luma_guest_count_check CHECK ((luma_guest_count >= 0))
constraint public.events events_organized_by_sponsors_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (organized_by) REFERENCES sponsors(id)
constraint public.events events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint public.events events_preview_image_images_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (preview_image) REFERENCES images(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
constraint public.events events_program_check CHECK ((program = ANY (ARRAY['talks'::text, 'open-floor'::text, 'social'::text, 'hackathon'::text])))
constraint public.events events_program_hackathon_check CHECK (((program = 'hackathon'::text) = is_hackathon))
constraint public.events events_slug_unique UNIQUE (slug)
constraint public.events events_topic_check CHECK (((char_length(topic) <= 24) AND (topic IS NFC NORMALIZED) AND (topic = lower((topic COLLATE pg_c_utf8))) AND (strpos(topic, 'all things'::text) = 0) AND ((topic COLLATE pg_c_utf8) ~ '^[[:alpha:][:digit:]](?:[[:alpha:][:digit:].&+#'']|(?<=[^ ]) (?=[^ ])|(?<=[[:alpha:][:digit:]])-(?=[[:alpha:][:digit:]]))*$'::text)))
constraint public.images images_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint public.profile_users profile_users_profile_id_profiles_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles(id)
constraint public.profile_users profile_users_profile_id_unique UNIQUE (profile_id)
constraint public.profile_users profile_users_profile_id_user_id_pk PRIMARY KEY (profile_id, user_id)
constraint public.profile_users profile_users_user_id_users_sync_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES neon_auth.users_sync(id)
constraint public.profiles profiles_image_images_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (image) REFERENCES images(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
constraint public.profiles profiles_luma_user_id_check CHECK ((luma_user_id ~ '^usr-[A-Za-z0-9]+$'::text))
constraint public.profiles profiles_luma_user_id_unique UNIQUE (luma_user_id)
constraint public.profiles profiles_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint public.redirects redirects_slug_unique PRIMARY KEY (slug)
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_name_unique UNIQUE (name)
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_square_logo_dark_images_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (square_logo_dark) REFERENCES images(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_square_logo_light_images_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (square_logo_light) REFERENCES images(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_bluesky_handle_check CHECK ((bluesky_handle ~ '^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?[.])+[a-z]{2,}$'::text))
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_linkedin_handle_check CHECK ((linkedin_handle ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,99}$'::text))
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_luma_user_id_check CHECK ((luma_user_id ~ '^usr-[A-Za-z0-9]+$'::text))
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_luma_user_id_unique UNIQUE (luma_user_id)
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_twitter_handle_check CHECK ((twitter_handle ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,15}$'::text))
constraint public.sponsors sponsors_website_url_check CHECK ((website_url ~ '^https://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(/[^[:space:]]*)?$'::text))
constraint public.talk_speakers talk_speakers_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['speaker'::text, 'moderator'::text])))
constraint public.talk_speakers talk_speakers_speaker_id_profiles_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (speaker_id) REFERENCES profiles(id)
constraint public.talk_speakers talk_speakers_talk_id_speaker_id_pk PRIMARY KEY (talk_id, speaker_id)
constraint public.talk_speakers talk_speakers_talk_id_talks_id_fk FOREIGN KEY (talk_id) REFERENCES talks(id)
constraint public.talks talks_format_check CHECK ((format = ANY (ARRAY['talk'::text, 'panel'::text, 'fireside'::text])))
constraint public.talks talks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
enum public.profile_type ('organizer', 'member')
